title: Cross-tenant probe 'LEAK' flags are only the requested path echoed in the Next.js RSC router state (no order data) — false positive, not a cross-tenant leak
where: GET /topup/TP-1040, /topup/status?number=TP-1040, /api/topup/orders/TP-1040?k=… with Host demo-shop.localhost / nope-tenant.localhost (apps/web/src/proxy.ts rewrite → not-found / site-status/no-site)
steps: curl -H 'Host: demo-shop.localhost' http://127.0.0.1:3000/topup/TP-1040 ; grep body for TP-1040, STEAM-, qa-steam@example.com
expected: 404 with no data of the demo-topup order
actual: 404 (Siam Atelier not-found page / RentWeb no-site page). Body contains 'TP-1040' exactly once, only inside the router state segment list ["","topup","TP-1040"] / q="?number=TP-1040"; 0 occurrences of STEAM- or the contact email. /api/topup/orders on demo-shop answers 404 {"error":"not found"} with no echo.
evidence: demo-shop /topup/TP-1040: status=404 num=1 steam=0 email=0 context: 0:{"P":"$1","c":["","topup","TP-1040"] ; nope-tenant same (title RentWeb no-site). Tenant scoping in services/orders.ts getOrderForCustomer/getOrderByNumber filters eq(topupOrders.tenantId, tenantId).
suggestedFix: None required for data safety. Optional: in topup_storefront-http.ts the LEAK heuristic should ignore the URL echo (compare against STEAM-/contact only).

title: /api/topup/feed answers 200 {items:[]} on a tenant that has no top-up module (demo-shop) instead of 404
actual: HTTP 200 {"items":[]} (every page route of the module returns 404 on this host)
suggestedFix: Load getRuntime(tenantId) in the route and return 404 when the tenant's modules do not include 'topup' (same for /api/topup/orders/[number] and /api/topup/stock/[packageId]).

title: Order number containing a NUL byte (%00) makes /api/topup/orders/[number] and the public /topup/status page return HTTP 500 instead of 404 / 'not found'
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/topup/orders/[number]/route.ts:14-16 and topup/status/page.tsx → services/orders.ts:357-365 getOrderByNumber (number.trim().toUpperCase() passed straight to Postgres)
expected: 404 {error:not found} / status page says ไม่พบรายการ
actual: API: status=500 empty body. Page /topup/status?number=TP-1040%00: HTTP 500 Next error page (__next_error__). Postgres rejects strings with 0x00.
suggestedFix: Validate the number with /^TP-\d{1,12}$/i (or strip control chars) before querying; return null → 404 / 'ไม่พบรายการ'.

title: /api/topup/feed?limit=2.5 (non-integer limit) returns HTTP 500 — limit is clamped but never rounded before SQL LIMIT
suggestedFix: Use Math.trunc / Number.isInteger guard: const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(Number(raw)) || 10, 1), 30).

title: Guest top-up order whose contact phone/e-mail belongs to an existing customer is silently attached to that customer's account (order + delivered code land in a stranger's history)
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:82-90 (upsertGuestCustomer returns the EXISTING customer → customerId reused); compare commerce orders.ts:143/220, rental stays.ts:181, events orders.ts:301 which refuse/handle via isCustomerBlocked and never expose the order to the matched account without ownership
steps: tooling/qa/bughunt/topup_storefront-svc.ts S1: createTopupOrder as guest (customer:null) with contact '081-234-5678' (phone of seeded customer 'ทดสอบ เติมเกม' 01a1401d-bea9-752e-882c-1f75b0c9438f), config otpRequiredFirstOrder:false (the module default; demo-topup only hides this because its config has the OTP gate on)
expected: Order stays a guest order (customer_id null or a separate guest row) — a phone typed by an anonymous visitor must not link the order (and its /account/topups visibility, delivered code, wallet refund target) to another person's account
actual: TP-1053 created with customer_id = 01a1401d-bea9-752e-882c-1f75b0c9438f (the existing customer). getOrderForCustomer(ownsIt) now lets that customer open the full order; failOrder would refund into that customer's wallet; the guest's per-hour quota is charged to the victim.
evidence: svc.out: 'S1 guest order TP-1053 created; order.customer_id=01a1401d-bea9-752e-882c-1f75b0c9438f existing(0812345678).id=01a1401d-bea9-752e-882c-1f75b0c9438f name=ทดสอบ เติมเกม → ATTACHED TO EXISTING CUSTOMER (merge)'
suggestedFix: Do not reuse a matched registered/verified customer for guest orders: keep customer_id null for guests (store contact only) or create/reuse a guest-only row; at minimum require the OTP/session before attaching to an existing account. Same rule as the other modules after the bug-fix phase.

title: Blocked customer (customers.blocked_at) is not refused by createTopupOrder — a shop-blocked customer can still place top-up orders as a guest with the same phone (and the service accepts a blocked customer id)
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:56-100 (no isCustomerBlocked call; commerce/rental/events call isCustomerBlocked before upsertGuestCustomer)
steps: svc.ts S2: upsertGuestCustomer phone 0868000001 → set blocked_at=now() → createTopupOrder as guest with contact 0868000001 (otp gate off); S2b: createTopupOrder with customer:{id: blocked}
expected: fail(customer_blocked) with CUSTOMER_BLOCKED_MESSAGE 'ขออภัย ไม่สามารถทำรายการได้ กรุณาติดต่อร้านโดยตรง'
actual: S2: order TP-1054 created and attached to the blocked customer; S2b: TP-1055 created. On demo-topup the UI path is only shielded because getCustomerByToken drops blocked sessions and the OTP gate then refuses guests (the guest sees the generic OTP message, not a block message).
evidence: svc.out: 'S2 BLOCKED customer (blocked_at set, phone 0868000001) could order as guest: TP-1054 customer_id=01a15032-8cbc-734d-8057-d9eae474d7a2 (== blocked …: true)' ; 'S2b createTopupOrder with customer={blocked id} accepted: TP-1055'
suggestedFix: In createTopupOrder, after contact normalisation: if (await isCustomerBlocked(tx, tenantId, { customerId: input.customer?.id, phone, email })) return fail(CUSTOMER_BLOCKED_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_BLOCKED_CODE); map the code in labels.ts ERROR_LABEL.

title: OTP-gate refusal (otp_required) still writes a customer row for the anonymous visitor's phone/e-mail — createTopupOrder upserts the guest customer BEFORE checking otpRequiredFirstOrder
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:82-91 (upsertGuestCustomer at :86, gate at :91; fail() does not roll back the transaction)
steps: svc.ts S3: createTopupOrder as guest with contact 0868000003 (new phone) and tenant config otpRequiredFirstOrder:true
expected: otp_required and no customer row (nothing persisted for a refused order)
actual: otp_required returned, but customers row created: before=0 after=1 (01a15033-bfdd-7433-a397-605be06e2941). Anyone can pollute the tenant's customer list / touch lastSeenAt of existing customers by posting refused orders.
evidence: svc.out: 'S3 otp gate: result otp_required; customers with phone 0868000003 before=0 after=1'
suggestedFix: Move the otpRequiredFirstOrder check (and the blocked/blacklist checks) above the upsertGuestCustomer call; only upsert once the order is actually going to be inserted.

title: Top-up module registers no payment closed handler: unpaid top-up / wallet top-up payments are never expired by the sweep, and cancelPayment() leaves the topup order stuck in pending_payment
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/handlers.ts:9-12 (only registerPaymentHandler); contract tooling/qa/bughunt/fixes/payments-api.md §3.2/§4 ('nothing is expired for a module that cannot release its target'); paymentHookSummary closed=[order,booking,patient_package,rest_order,reservation,stay,ticket_order] — no topup / wallet_topup
steps: svc.ts S4: create promptpay order TP-1056, set its payment expires_at = now()-2h, run expireStalePayments(db,{graceMinutes:0}); S4b: cancelPayment(tx, tenant, paymentId, 'qa cancel')
expected: payment → expired and order → cancelled (like commerce orders); cancelPayment → order cancelled with reason
actual: sweep expired 8 payments of other modules but skipped this one: payment.status=pending, order.status=pending_payment. cancelPayment → payment 'cancelled' but topup order still pending_payment (customer page keeps showing 'รอชำระเงิน' with a dead payment; wallet_topups likewise stay pending forever).
evidence: svc.out: 'S4 sweep: … expireStalePayments → {"expired":8,"skipped":0,"errors":0}; payment.status=pending order.status=pending_payment' ; 'S4b cancelPayment(runHandler default) → cancelled; order.status after=pending_payment' ; S0 paymentHookSummary closed list lacks topup/wallet_topup
suggestedFix: registerPaymentClosedHandler('topup', …) → if order.status==='pending_payment' && order.paymentId===payment.id → status 'cancelled', failureReason reason, emit topup.cancelled; registerPaymentClosedHandler('wallet_topup', …) → wallet_topups.status 'cancelled'/'expired'. Order page: when payment is expired/cancelled show 'หมดเวลาชำระ' + re-order CTA instead of the dead PaymentPanel.

title: failOrder() on a slip/PromptPay-paid order records refundRequired only on topup_orders.supplier_response — the payment row is never flagged (paymentRefundRequired(payment) = null), so the shared payments admin/notification path does not know money must be returned
where: packages/modules/topup/src/services/orders.ts:300-302 (supplierResponse.refundRequired = true) vs payments-api.md §3.1 (providerPayload.refundRequired / failureReason 'ต้องคืนเงิน: …' / event payment.refund_required); onTopupPaid (:200-216) returns void instead of refundRequired(reason) when fulfilment fails (e.g. out_of_stock at :251)
steps: svc.ts S5: join failed topup orders with their payments
expected: payments.provider_payload.refundRequired set (reason, at) and failure_reason 'ต้องคืนเงิน: …' for every failed order paid by slip/QR
actual: TP-1048, TP-1038, TP-1032, TP-1026, TP-1020: order supplier_response.refundRequired='true' but payment status 'paid' with provider_payload.refundRequired = null (failure_reason either null or the admin note). Customer tracker says 'ทีมงานจะคืนเงินผ่านช่องทางเดิมภายใน 24 ชม.' while nothing in the payment layer tracks it.
suggestedFix: In onTopupPaid return refundRequired(reason) when fulfillOrder ends failed; in failOrder for paid non-wallet orders call the payment layer's refund-required flagging (same helper markPaid uses) so payment.refund_required event/admin badge fire.

title: On game pages at 390px the fixed mobile order-summary bar permanently hides the footer's last row (นโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัว / เงื่อนไขการใช้บริการ links) — they cannot be scrolled into view

title: demo-topup tier prices are stored with satang (e.g. VIP 3234 = ฿32.34, agent 17005 = ฿170.05) so package tiles show odd prices like 'ตัวแทน ฿170.05' and VIP/agent customers are charged fractional baht

title: Player-ID fields accept anything (Thai text, emoji, Riot ID without #, any length ≤120) — no numeric/pattern validation although the template's own instructions say 'UID 9 หลัก' / 'ตัวเลข 9–12 หลัก' / 'Name#TAG'; the order is then paid and 'fulfilled' against a bogus id
where: packages/templates/src/topup.ts:138-145 (every field type:'text', no pattern/min/max), packages/db/src/schema/topup.ts:7-15 GameField (no pattern/minLength), packages/modules/topup/src/services/catalog.ts:137-152 validatePlayerFields (only required / ≤120 / digits for type number / select options), topup-form.tsx:100 (pattern only for type number)
steps: Signed in on /games/genshin: UID '  ทดสอบ🙂 ', Server Asia, PromptPay → submit; /games/valorant riotid 'NoTagHere' → form.checkValidity()
expected: Client + server reject non-numeric UIDs for RoV/Free Fire/Genshin/PUBG/MLBB (and Riot ID without #TAG); at least inputMode numeric + pattern on phone
actual: Order TP-1061 created with player_fields {"uid":"ทดสอบ🙂","server":"Asia"} (trimmed, otherwise accepted); valorant 'NoTagHere' checkValidity=true; free-fire uid input has pattern=null inputmode=text. After slip auto-approval the simulated api fulfilment marks such an order fulfilled, i.e. money is taken for an id the supplier cannot credit.

suggestedFix: Seed numeric ids as type:'number' (RoV/Free Fire/Genshin/PUBG/MLBB uid+zone) and extend GameField with optional pattern/minLength/maxLength (e.g. Genshin ^\d{9}$, Riot ID ^.{3,16}#.{3,5}$); enforce in validatePlayerFields and mirror as input pattern/inputMode in TopupForm with a field-specific Thai error.

title: 'ยกเลิก' on a pending wallet top-up only navigates back to /wallet — the wallet_topup and its payment stay pending (nothing is cancelled, and per STOREFRONT-08 they never expire)
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/wallet/page.tsx:109-111 (<Link href="/wallet">ยกเลิก</Link>, no server action / cancelPayment)
steps: Signed in, /wallet → custom amount 20 → เติมเงิน → payment panel → click ยกเลิก
expected: wallet_topups.status cancelled + payment cancelled via cancelPayment(tx, tenant, id, reason) (payment.cancelled event), or the link labelled 'กลับ' instead of 'ยกเลิก'
actual: URL returns to /wallet with no pending-topup list; DB: {topup_status:'pending', payment_status:'pending'}; pendingTopupsForCustomer=1 remains and the admin sees an open ฿20 payment forever
evidence: topup_storefront-live.out: "wallet: second pending top-up (min ฿20) → 'ยกเลิก' link — … after ยกเลิก: {\"topup_status\":\"pending\",\"payment_status\":\"pending\"} pendingTopupsForCustomer=1"
suggestedFix: Make ยกเลิก a server action that calls cancelPayment(tx, tenantId, paymentId, 'ลูกค้ายกเลิก') and sets wallet_topups.status='cancelled' (with the closed handler from STOREFRONT-08 doing the same on expiry).

title: Wallet custom-amount field mis-parses input: '1e3' becomes ฿13, Thai digits (๑๐๐) are silently ignored (previous amount kept), no inline error
where: packages/modules/topup/src/components/wallet-topup-form.tsx:42-46 (v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'') then Math.round(Number(v)*100); non-positive results keep the old amount)

suggestedFix: Use inputMode=decimal + pattern, convert Thai digits (๐-๙) to ASCII, parse with toSatang(), reset amount to 0 / show 'จำนวนเงินไม่ถูกต้อง' when the parse fails.

title: Frozen wallet is invisible until a submit fails: /wallet shows no 'ถูกระงับ' notice and the game page still offers 'กระเป๋าเงินในเว็บ คงเหลือ ฿271 · ตัดทันที' as the default method

title: Client IP is never recorded for top-up orders in this environment (topup_orders.ip NULL on every order, UI-created included) so the per-IP order limit, IP blacklist and 'repeat_ip' risk flag are inert unless a proxy sets X-Real-IP / TRUSTED_PROXY is configured
where: packages/core/src/customer/request-meta.ts:60-72 clientIp() (X-Forwarded-For only with TRUSTED_PROXY hops, else X-Real-IP, no fallback) → apps/web/src/lib/customer.ts:38 requestMeta → services/orders.ts:40-50 countRecentOrders / blacklistChecksFor(ip)
steps: Place orders through the browser on demo-topup; select ip from topup_orders; customer B hit the 10/hour limit while customer A on the same machine could still order (TP-1075)
expected: Per-IP limit shares the hourly budget across customers behind one IP (as documented 'max orders per customer / IP'); ip stored for fraud review
actual: All 75 orders have ip = null; 'IP orders in last hour before=0'; A's order TP-1075 accepted right after B was refused. In production this depends entirely on the reverse proxy setting X-Real-IP (a client can also send that header itself when no TRUSTED_PROXY hop strips it).
evidence: topup_storefront-live.out ratelimit steps: 'IP orders in last hour before=0; B succeeded 10 (last TP-1074) then alert="ทำรายการถี่เกินไป กรุณาลองใหม่ในอีกสักครู่"' ; 'A own orders last hour=4 → {"kind":"order","number":"TP-1075"…}' ; SQL: every topup_orders.ip null
suggestedFix: Document/verify the deployment sets X-Real-IP (or TRUSTED_PROXY) and log a startup warning when clientIp() is null for a non-local request; consider a last-resort fallback (e.g. the connecting socket via a custom header injected by proxy.ts) so anti-fraud limits are not silently disabled.

title: Rate-limit refusal copy 'ทำรายการถี่เกินไป กรุณาลองใหม่ในอีกสักครู่' understates the wait — the window is a rolling 60 minutes and counts failed/cancelled/pending attempts too

evidence: topup_storefront-live.out: 'B succeeded 10 (last TP-1074) then alert="ทำรายการถี่เกินไป กรุณาลองใหม่ในอีกสักครู่"'; screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-topup-ratelimit-1440.png
suggestedFix: Make the label mention the hourly cap (use cfg.maxOrdersPerHour) and show a link to /account/topups for unpaid orders; consider not counting cancelled/failed orders.
